scoring_justification: Checker recomputes end charges from the raw CHELPG charges CSV and a point‑charge voltage, then compares to paper‑reported values within tolerances. This is T1.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper‑reported target values: terminal voltage ΔU=17.2 mV, left end charge +0.134 e, right end charge −0.005 e.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper (Figure 2b and text): 'total charges on the left were 0.134 e and on the right were −0.005 e.', 'voltage difference … ΔU = 17.2 mV'.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact quantities the reproduction must match within tolerance; the checker compares against the paper itself.

outputs.description: CHELPG partial charges for all atoms in four instantaneous configurations (config_id 1–4). Columns: config_id int, atom_index int, element string, x/y/z float in Å, charge float in elementary charge e.
Reported terminal voltage (ΔU in mV) and axial-averaged total charges on left and right tube ends (in elementary charge), averaged over the four configurations.

output_contract.notes: The derived values should be self-consistent with the cheLPG_charges.csv; the checker will verify internal consistency and compare reported values to a hidden reference within tolerances.

steps.description: CSV exists, has required columns, contains exactly 4 configurations and carbon atoms.
Recompute axial end charges from carbon atoms and compare to paper gold (Q_left=0.134, Q_right=−0.005 e).
Read reported terminal voltage and end charges; compare to paper gold with tolerances.
Cross‑check: reported Q_left / Q_right / ΔU must match recomputed values from CSV within looser tolerances.
